verdict.rationale: Codegen's core product is a built-in AI agent. Users delegate development tasks to it through prompts, the web UI, Slack, Linear/Jira, GitHub mentions, the CLI and the SDK. It implements features, fixes bugs, writes tests, presents structured plans and opens PRs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of delegated task quality beyond vendor docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Analyze requirements, implement features, fix bugs, write tests, and improve documentation based on your prompts.
Add the Codegen Slack App to communicate with the agent directly in your workspace.
Create and manage AI agents that can write code, fix bugs, and handle development tasks across your repositories
Agents will present a structured plan showing each implementation step
task = agent.run(prompt="Leave a review on PR #123")
Agents can create new pull requests with code changes
